## Summary

Describe the behavior or policy changed and the requirement or issue it implements.

## Provenance declarations

- [ ] I declare the source provenance used for this change.
- [ ] I declare the fixture provenance or confirm that no fixtures are added.

List the relevant standards, documentation, observable behavior, synthetic generators, and fixture
rights here. Confirm that no TES5Edit Reference Snapshot code was copied, mechanically translated,
or structure-preservingly adapted. Disclose dependencies, native bytes, branding, patent, EULA, or
third-party-rights questions.

External contributors must sign every commit under DCO 1.1 as described in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
Unclear rights or provenance are stop-before-merge conditions even when automated checks pass.
